definitions.explanation: A grammatical term referring to words that name people, things, places, or concepts.

examples.japanese: {形容詞|けいようし}は{名詞|めいし}を{修飾|しゅうしょく}する。
{日本語|にほんご}の{名詞|めいし}には{単数形|たんすうけい}と{複数形|ふくすうけい}の{区別|くべつ}がない。
examples.english: Japanese nouns do not distinguish between singular and plural.

notes:
{名詞|めいし} is a grammar term referring to nouns as a part of speech.

Note: {名詞|めいし} (noun, grammar term) and {名刺|めいし} (business card) are homophones with different kanji.

RELATED TERMS:
- {名詞|めいし}: noun
- {動詞|どうし}: verb
- {形容詞|けいようし}: adjective
- {副詞|ふくし}: adverb
- {助詞|じょし}: particle
